sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify formal vocabulary and official register markers, then contrast formal and informal variants
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите деловую лексику и маркеры официального стиля, сравните формальные и неформальные варианты

items.prompt: Which is the formal equivalent of 'этот документ'?
items.hint: The formal word for 'this' in documents is данный.
items.explanation: Данный документ is standard in official writing. Этот is conversational; такой means 'such'; тот means 'that.'

items.prompt: What is the formal nominalized equivalent of 'помочь'?
items.promptEnglish: Formal writing replaces verbs with noun + verb constructions.
items.hint: The collocating verb for помощь is оказать.
items.explanation: Оказать помощь (to render assistance) is the standard nominalized form. Помочь is fine in speech but too casual for official documents.

items.promptEnglish: A formulaic prepositional phrase governing the instrumental case.
items.explanation: В соответствии с (+ instrumental) means 'in accordance with.' В целях = 'for the purpose of,' на основании = 'on the basis of,' в связи с = 'in connection with.'

items.prompt: Choose the correct formal opening for 'We hereby inform you...'
items.promptEnglish: Standard opening formula in official letters.
items.explanation: Настоящим сообщаем is the standard impersonal opening. 'Мы хотим сказать' is colloquial. 'Мы сообщаем вам' is acceptable but less formal.

items.prompt: Which sentence uses the impersonal passive correctly?
items.promptEnglish: Impersonal passive avoids naming the agent.
items.hint: Passive: noun + было + short past participle.
items.explanation: Решение было принято (A decision was made) is impersonal passive, standard in formal writing. 'Мы приняли' names the agent, which formal style avoids.

minimalPairs.context: Choose the formal version of 'We decided to...'
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Official documents avoid first-person plural decisions.
minimalPairs.explanation: Было принято решение (A decision was made) uses impersonal passive, avoiding 'мы.' This is standard in formal documents.

minimalPairs.context: Choose the formal way to say 'because of the delay':
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Formal causal phrase with instrumental case.
minimalPairs.explanation: В связи с (+ instrumental) is the formal causal phrase. Из-за (+ genitive) is neutral/informal and sounds too blunt in official writing.

minimalPairs.context: Choose the formal way to say 'for the purpose of improving':
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Stating the purpose of an official action.
minimalPairs.explanation: В целях (+ genitive noun) is the formal purpose formula. Чтобы + infinitive is standard grammar but too plain for official documents.

translation.english: We hereby notify you of the schedule change.
translation.answer: Настоящим уведомляем Вас об изменении расписания.
acceptableVariants: Настоящим уведомляем Вас об изменении графика.
Настоящим сообщаем Вас об изменении расписания.
translation.hint: Use настоящим + уведомляем + Вас (formal) + об + prepositional.

translation.english: A decision was made to postpone the meeting.
translation.answer: Было принято решение о переносе совещания.
translation.hint: Use impersonal passive: было принято решение + о + prepositional noun.

translation.english: In accordance with the contract terms...
For the purpose of improving working conditions...
